evidence_kind: actual native outputs and controlled synthetic measurements
procedure_executed: Executed three native procedure arms on identical cases and a capacity-intervention model.
observed_result: All three arms scored 12/12; the nine capacity contexts favored summary intervention in five, approval intervention in three, and tied once. No global mechanism wins.
limits: Procedure arms are not live implementation of all three organizational intervention families.
The family choices are tested only through controlled decisions and capacity models.
No independent replication or real operating-cost weights.
